source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

Neither party shall disclose the Confidential Information received from the other to any person or entity, except its employees, officers, directors, independent consultants, affiliates, subsidiaries and other agents (collectively “Representatives”) involved in the performance of the Project, or to use the Confidential Information for any purpose other than fulfilling its obligations under the Project.”"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disclosure_locator_v2", "operation": "locate_disclosure_windows_v2", "unit_ids": [0, 5, 10, 13, 16, 17, 18, 21, 22, 23, 26, 28, 29, 32, 33, 34, 36, 39, 41, 42, 45, 46, 48, 50, 52, 55, 57, 59, 60, 61, 62, 65, 67, 69, 71, 73], "current_units": [{"id": 0, "text": "FORS CERTIFICATION BODY NON DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT This Agreement is made XX…day of XX 20XX BETWEEN AECOM Limited, company number 01846493, whose registered office is 63-77 Victoria Street, St Albans, Hertfordshire, AL1 3ER."}, {"id": 5, "text": "AND [Company name, number and address.] The above parties being referred to in this Agreement as the “Parties” or individually as the “Party” BACKGROUND (A) The Parties have each requested the other to make available confidential information concerning the other for the purposes of evaluating [Company name] becoming a Fleet Operator Recognition Scheme (FORS) certification body which would mean that it would be approved by FORS to undertake fee earning audits on members who would then be accredited and recognised as FORS operators (the “Permitted Purpose”)."}, {"id": 10, "text": "(B) For their mutual benefit, the Parties wish to exchange such confidential information 1. RECEIVING PARTY’S OBLIGATIONS In consideration of the disclosing of Confidential Information to each other, each Party undertakes to the other Party:- 2.1.1 to keep the Confidential Information secret and acknowledges the proprietary nature of the Confidential Information;"}, {"id": 16, "text": "2.1.2 to use it only for the Permitted Purpose;"}, {"id": 17, "text": "2.1.3 not to disclose it to anyone or to make copies of it unless this Agreement expressly permits such disclosure or the prior written consent of the other Party is given."}, {"id": 18, "text": "2.2 The above duties of confidentiality shall not apply to information that the receiving Party can demonstrate by reasonable documentary proof:- 2.2.1 to have been in the public domain at the time of receipt or to subsequently entered the public domain through no fault of the receiving Party;"}, {"id": 21, "text": "2.2.2 to have been lawfully known by the receiving Party prior to its receipt; or"}, {"id": 22, "text": "2.2.3 to have been disclosed to the receiving Party without restriction by a third party."}, {"id": 23, "text": "3. PERMITTED DISCLOSURE 3.1 The receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information:"}, {"id": 26, "text": "3.1.1 only to such employees of the receiving Party as are strictly necessary for the Permitted Purpose; and/or 3.1.2 as required by any order of any court of competent jurisdiction or any competent judicial, governmental or regularly body."}, {"id": 28, "text": "3.2 Prior to disclosure of any Confidential Information under Clause 3.1.2, the receiving Party shall (to the extent permitted by law) inform the disclosing Party of the complete circumstances and the details of the information to be disclosed."}, {"id": 29, "text": "4. THIRD PARTIES 4.1 The receiving Party shall notify anyone to whom it is authorised to disclose the Confidential Information that it is confidential and procure that they comply with this Agreement."}, {"id": 32, "text": "On the request of the disclosing Party, the receiving Party shall procure that they enter into a confidentiality agreement on terms and conditions no less onerous than those contained in this Agreement."}, {"id": 33, "text": "4.2 Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other Party."}, {"id": 34, "text": "4.3 This Agreement shall not confer and shall not purport to confer on any third party any benefit or any right to enforce any term of this Agreement for the purposes of the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 or otherwise."}, {"id": 36, "text": "5. COPIES 5.1 The receiving Party shall acquire no proprietary interest in or right to the Confidential Information supplied to it by the disclosing Party."}, {"id": 39, "text": "5.1.1 The receiving Party may only make such copies of Confidential Information as are expressly authorised by the disclosing Party for the Permitted Purpose and for disclosures that are not in breach of this Agreement."}, {"id": 41, "text": "The receiving Party will clearly label all copies of Confidential Information as confidential."}, {"id": 42, "text": "5.2 If the disclosing Party so requests in writing, the receiving Party shall immediately:- 5.2.1 return all Confidential Information including copies to the disclosing Party; and"}, {"id": 45, "text": "5.2.2 destroy or permanently erase all copies made by the receiving Party and procure that anyone to whom the receiving Party has supplied copies destroys or permanently erases such copies and any further copies made by them."}, {"id": 46, "text": "6.
